narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, I see your convictions are strong. Not many will face that council of fiends!

Here's your ring, adventurer. May your will, and your fortune, stand firm.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, if you plan to go after the Abyssal High Council again, then you'll need another Twilight ring of lordship. Bring me more shards and signets and I'll make one for you.
